title: Using a FlexLine: Draw Conditions and Funding
content:
These are the conditions under which a draw is made on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.

## Conditions in force

1. **Destination.** A draw is sent only to a linked bank account of the borrower whose verification status is verified. The verification status is read from Larkspur's record of that bank account, for the account the draw is sent to, before the draw is made.
2. **Size and frequency.** A draw must be at least the tier's minimum draw, may not exceed the available credit (the credit limit less the outstanding balance), may not take the day's draws above the tier's daily maximum, and may not exceed the tier's draws per billing cycle; a draw that breaks any of these is refused, never partly funded, and no over-limit fee exists.
3. **Funding.** Funds arrive the tier's funding business days after the request (same business day for a tier showing 0 when requested by the cutoff).
4. **Phone draws.** Draws by phone carry no extra fee.

The day's draws are the draws posted on the line on the calendar day of the request; the billing cycle runs from the day after the last statement closing date through the current day.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis and are kept here only as the earlier text:

> Draws are allowed only while the line is in active status.

> Each draw carries a draw fee of the tier's draw fee percent of the draw, rounded to the cent and not less than the tier's minimum draw fee (no fee where the percent is 0.00), added to the balance on the draw date; the draw fee counts toward the balance but not toward the daily maximum.

## Size and frequency limits in combination

A draw is funded only if every row below reads "met"; one "not met" refuses the whole draw.

| Test | Met when |
|---|---|
| Minimum | the draw is at least the tier's smallest draw |
| Available credit | the draw is no more than the credit limit less the outstanding balance |
| Daily maximum | the day's draws including this one are no more than the tier's daily maximum |
| Cycle count | this draw does not exceed the tier's number of draws per billing cycle |

*Hypothetical case:* a FlexLine Standard line with a 5000.00 USD limit and a 4200.00 USD outstanding balance has 800.00 USD of available credit. A requested 900.00 USD draw is refused in full; it is not reduced to 800.00 USD.
